title: Glow
paper_title: Glow: Generative Flow with Invertible 1×1 Convolutions
core_mech: Glow 在 RealNVP coupling 上加入数据依赖 ActNorm 和可学习可逆 1×1 通道卷积。
core_mech_en: Enhances multi-scale affine coupling flows with activation normalization (ActNorm) and learnable invertible 1×1 channel convolutions parameterized via LU decomposition.
output_desc: 精确似然和层级潜变量，或由潜变量反演的生成图像
output_en: Hierarchical latent variables z, exact log-likelihood log p(x), and exact latent-to-image synthesis

source.title: Glow
notes: The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.

adapter.name: Glow
adapter.mechanism: Squeeze, data-initialized ActNorm, invertible learned 1x1 mixing and affine coupling provide exact likelihood and inversion.
limitations: One scale, full matrix determinant/inverse rather than LU acceleration, no hierarchical latent splits.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
